rule: Never wake another BB thread (bb thread tell, relay ask, notices) with an informational note that needs no action; every message to a chat idle for hours forces a full-context cache rewrite. Message another chat only when it must act now; otherwise put the note in your own report.

In cakekeeper, when a post-merge screens/e2e check fails on main, re-run it yourself with explicit free ports (CK_SCREENS_API_PORT/CK_SCREENS_WEB_PORT, CK_SCREENS_OUT under /tmp); if it passes, cancel the -mainfix task instead of letting a writer hunt a port race.

Never put paths outside the project (../other-plugin/...) anywhere in a task contract, not even in read_first or never_touch: quote the needed facts from the sibling repo in the plan instead. A rejected contract with such a path stays in the run scope and blocks every later task of the run.

Do not put `npm run check:translations` (packages/i18n) in a SelfyStudio task's verification: it fails on ~158 pre-existing missing keys (menu, bot, purpose, duo.whoSecond). For i18n copy tasks check named tests (packages/i18n src/__tests__/no-collisions, icu-messages, module-loading) plus a key-set-unchanged-vs-HEAD script.

When main is merged into a task worktree, resolve conflicts only inside the task's owns_paths and keep main's version of every other file; after the merge, `git diff --name-status <main-parent> HEAD` must list only owns_paths files. PM: before deploying, check each new merge commit with that diff and restore any file deleted or reverted outside the task's owns_paths.

When the owner performs a step of a live test (presses Start, pays, opens a link), watch the outcome yourself right away (order status in DB, queue, logs) and report or fix it before he has to ask; never leave him waiting for a result you can check.

In SelfyStudio, do not start scripts/deploy.sh while the post-merge integration gate (`npm test -- --force`) is still running: the Docker build pushes load to 10-13 and the gate then fails on ~30 unrelated apps/api tests that pass in isolation. Wait for the gate result first, or when it fails during a deploy, rerun a sample of the failing files in isolation before dispatching any fix.
Chain parallel tasks that edit the same i18n keys or shared UI file (ui/i18n.ts, ui/keys.tsx) with depends_on instead of running them side by side.

In every SelfyStudio writer contract that edits apps/marketing or apps/cabinet, add `npm run lint` with cwd set to that package and `npx vitest run no-hardcoded-ui-copy.test.ts` with cwd tests/architecture to verification; the standard release gate runs both and one error blocks every deploy.

Never end a turn by asking the owner whether to fix a technical defect you found (red tests, a blocked deploy gate, a Lane Pilot bug): diagnose it to a verified root cause and dispatch the fix in the same turn. Ask only for money, irreversible data, secrets or a product decision.
Подключай секции поздравительных открыток через разрешённый `CardPageRenderer.vue` и проверяй порядок в разрешённых тестах `greeting-cards/__tests__/`, не меняя `CardContentBlocks.vue`.
Перед ответом сверяй все изменённые пути с `owns_paths` и `never_touch`; если нужный путь не разрешён, не меняй его и остановись с `NEEDS_HUMAN`, указав блокирующий путь.
Перед изменением каждого файла в SelfyStudio сверяй его путь с `owns_paths` и `never_touch` текущего задания; если нужный файл не разрешён, остановись и запроси исправление контракта до правок.

When a feature adds or uses a new helper on the native-step helpers object, wire it in host/plugin.ts at every place the helpers are built and add a test against the real host wiring, not only a stubbed helper.

In Content Factory db/store.ts add a new migration ONLY as the last element of MIGRATIONS, even when it alters a table defined earlier; never insert next to related migrations. Then append it to db/migrations.lock.json.

Pick SelfyStudio login providers by visitor IP country, never by browser language: CIS (RU, BY, KZ, UZ, KG, TJ, AM, AZ, MD, TM) shows Telegram, VK ID, Yandex ID, email; outside the CIS shows Telegram, Google, email; Google never for RU. Every ported prototype button must lead to the real target; verify login buttons by following them, not by screenshots.
On SelfyStudio layout fixes, change only what the owner pointed at; do not add your own layout tweaks (spacing, distribution) to the task. Ask or mention them as an option instead.

When starting a SelfyStudio scenario run with an admin-session.sh session, keep that session alive until the run finishes: the runner calls admin APIs on behalf of the starter (e.g. seed_photos → GET /v1/admin/scenarios/meta-prompts). Revoke the session only after the run ends. Evidence: 2026-10-13 run 4147ab2b failed at seed_photos with 401 'Admin session is inactive or revoked' because the session was revoked right after start.

Before running any content seed script with --apply against production, read the dry-run's final values of title/h1/description for every record (not just changed key names) and back up the current records; after apply, curl each touched public page and check its <title> at once.

In bb-plugin-lane-pilot, never use the full vitest suite as a task's verification command: list the test files covering the changed code and run that set outside the sandbox yourself before dispatch. Several suite tests (tests/verification/**, tests/scenarios.test.ts S5) fail only inside Lane Pilot's Seatbelt check.

When deploying SelfyStudio from a temp worktree, symlink the main checkout's node_modules and .env into it and run `npm -w packages/application run build` before scripts/deploy.sh when scenario-runner is affected; the scenario-engine preflight needs packages/application/dist/scenario-agents and fails without it. Run as root, `claude` CLI preflight fails, so pass SCENARIO_ENGINE_REQUIRED_CLIS='opencode'.

On unexplained TS2305, missing-export or 'not a constructor' errors in a worktree, rebuild package dists first (`npm -w <pkg> run build`, bypassing the turbo cache) and re-check the main baseline before touching code; rebuild dists after merging new package exports.

Treat items the SelfyStudio owner names with «например» as illustrations, not a spec: before building a catalog or page around them, propose a varied set yourself and ship visual examples first; for showcase content do not gate on keyword demand.

Every section on SelfyStudio marketing pages uses the canonical .section__head stack (eyebrow, then H2, then subtitle, left-aligned in the container); never split the eyebrow/subtitle and the H2 into separate columns, and check new or extended blocks against the other heads on the same page before acceptance.

For the SelfyStudio site v2 port, do NOT restyle or extend the old marketing components: archive the old design untouched as its own complete design, and integrate the prototype (.agents/prototypes/site/home-v2/visual: tokens, base/shared CSS, per-block CSS, JS, markup) from scratch as a separate design in the Nuxt engine, one prototype block = one new component, so the site has two complete designs side by side. This replaces the earlier rule «compose pages from the existing native marketing components».
For D3 lint probe tasks, rewrite `notes/lpv/d3.md` in the current worktree with the requested `D3` line, even if the file already exists, then verify it before answering.

In every apps/marketing writer contract add `npm run lint` (eslint + stylelint, cwd apps/marketing) and `npx vitest run tests/` (cwd apps/marketing: fitness and source-contract tests) to verification; scoped vitest dirs alone let lint errors, fitness regressions and tests/*.test.ts contract breaks reach main.

When a SelfyStudio change adds a request field that the site sends to the API, list every hop it passes (apps/site → Angie → apps/marketing server/api proxy → apps/api) and update each proxy that rebuilds the body with an allowlist; prove it with one real request whose DB row or log shows the field arrived.

When the integration gate (`npm test -- --force`) fails across many unrelated workspaces that no merged task touched, first rerun each failing workspace's vitest in isolation; if they pass, treat the failure as host-load flakiness (many concurrent writers) and do not dispatch fix tasks. Evidence: 2026-10-12 gate failed on ~50 tests in bot-thin, image-providers, cache-redis, event-bus-bullmq, worker and cabinet with load avg 8; all of them passed in isolation.

Add `npx vitest run` with cwd tests/architecture (the whole release-gate architecture suite, about a minute) to the verification of every SelfyStudio writer task that edits apps/* or packages/* source; the gate checks file-size budgets, dead components and NO-CYRILLIC, and one miss blocks every deploy. Evidence: 2026-10-12, three gate breaks in a row: ArticleBody baseline, seo-clusters size and dead components, localization/service.ts 420 LOC.

Before launching a new SelfyStudio locale prefix (/es/, /de/, …), delete its `location = /xx { return 404; }` and `location ^~ /xx/ { return 404; }` lines in /etc/angie/sites-enabled/selfystudio.art.conf (backup, angie -t, systemctl reload angie); the edge 404s the prefix before the marketing app sees it.

In every SelfyStudio task contract that adds, splits or removes Vue components (admin, marketing, cabinet), add a verification step `npx vitest run admin-vue-page-size.test.ts nuxt-dead-components.test.ts marketing-i18n-completeness.test.ts` with cwd tests/architecture: the release gate runs them and blocks the deploy. Evidence: admin-seo-clusters-two-pane (fb68b9775e, 2026-10-12) passed its own checks but failed the gate on file size and dead components.

Give each task only checks focused on its change (typecheck plus tests related to the touched files, e.g. `npx vitest related <files> --run`), never the whole test suite; the full suite runs once per batch as the integration gate, and its failures go back to the writer whose change caused them.

For treba-sites subfolder projects (templates/blog etc.), do not dispatch writer tasks with file expected_outputs until Lane Pilot 0.1.164 is deployed; keep contract paths relative to the project folder.

In bb-plugin-lane-pilot, exclude 'tests/verification/sandbox*.test.ts' (plus tests/guard*.test.ts and tests/native-session-hooks.test.ts) from any full-suite verification command: they cannot nest sandbox-exec inside Lane Pilot's Seatbelt check and always fail there.

When a task contract owns a source file or glob (e.g. apps/marketing/app/composables/useHreflang.ts), also put its colocated tests (e.g. apps/marketing/app/composables/__tests__/useHreflang*) in owns_paths, or in never_touch if they must not change.

In cakekeeper UI work, take ready shadcn/ui (Base UI flavour) components and blocks via the shadcn CLI into packages/ui-web and theme them with tokens; never hand-write a primitive, picker, sidebar, table or dialog that shadcn already provides.

In muse, the sandbox HOME differs, so write every Rust verification command as `RUSTUP_HOME=/home/ubuntu/.rustup CARGO_HOME=/home/ubuntu/.cargo RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=stable /home/ubuntu/.cargo/bin/cargo ...` (cwd rust-sync); a PATH prefix alone fails with 'rustup could not choose a version'. Evidence: qtickets-rebind-2, 2026-10-09.
For one-note drill tasks, create only the named drill file and remove any changes to other paths before answering.

Before resending a blocked task, check the dispatch warnings: if it now waits on an open task (owns_paths overlap) that itself depends on it, cancel that downstream gate task and dispatch it again after the resend, so the queue cannot deadlock.

In cakekeeper, use YooKassa for subscription payments (env YOOKASSA_SHOP_ID, YOOKASSA_SECRET_KEY; test store) and never add CloudPayments code or env names, even though site/spec/STACK.md still names CloudPayments.

When narrowing a role's context (ROLE_PROFILES, helper.access), never strip the code-intelligence tools a code-working role needs: writers, repair writers and the code critic keep the gitnexus MCP server; cut only catalogs, skills and servers unrelated to the job.
When setting a model for Content Factory scenario steps or helper runs, also set serviceTier "default" explicitly; the owner does not want fast mode used.

In cakekeeper Playwright runs inside Lane Pilot checks, launch the default chromium headless shell with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH under ${TMPDIR:-/tmp} (as the apps/web `screens` script does); never use channel 'chromium', full Chrome or a persistent userDataDir, which fail with 'Failed to create a ProcessSingleton' in the sandbox.

In a verification command, name a test folder with a trailing slash (`npx vitest run tests/server/`), never a bare prefix: vitest filters are substrings, so `tests/server` also runs tests/server-reconcile.test.ts and other files the task does not own.

When a SelfyStudio release includes a Prisma migration, apply it with db-migrate.sh deploy, then run `sudo -n env DATABASE_URL=<compose PG at 127.0.0.1:5436> node scripts/collect-release-evidence.mjs migration --classification rollback-safe --receipt <dir>/<id>-migration.json --evidence <dir>/<id>-migration.evidence.json` with both files in one root:root 750 directory (files root 0400), and pass --migration-receipt to deploy.sh within the 1 h expiry.

In SelfyStudio tasks that touch payment or billing code (apps/cabinet/app/features/billing, payment providers), add `npx vitest run payment-provider-registry.test.ts` (cwd tests/architecture) to verification, and type provider ids with the shared Provider type (payment-chips.ts / contracts PaymentProvider), never a hand-written union of 3+ provider ids.

For SelfyStudio Nuxt apps, never read backend URLs from process.env in nuxt.config (runtimeConfig defaults or routeRules proxies): the Docker build has no such env, so the value is baked as the localhost default. Read them at runtime (runtimeConfig overridden by NUXT_* env, or a server route), and verify a build made with NO backend env, started with only NUXT_* vars, before accepting.

In vue-i18n locale JSON (marketing, cabinet, admin) never write a bare @, | or unbalanced { } in a message; write a literal at-sign as {'@'} (e.g. "{'@'}SelfyStudioBot"), otherwise SSR fails with 500 and message "10" (INVALID_LINKED_FORMAT).

When a SelfyStudio release has a Prisma migration, apply it with db-migrate.sh deploy, then collect the receipt in the deploy worktree: sudo -n env DATABASE_URL=<.env URL with @postgres:5432 → 127.0.0.1:<compose postgres port>> node scripts/collect-release-evidence.mjs migration --classification rollback-safe --receipt /var/lib/selfystudio-release-evidence/<id>-migration.json --evidence …evidence.json (parent dir root-owned 0750), and pass --migration-receipt to deploy.sh.

In bb-plugin-lane-pilot contracts, never use a bare `npx vitest run` as verification: Lane Pilot's sandboxed check cannot run tests/verification/**, tests/scenarios.test.ts, tests/pipeline.test.ts or tests/acceptance-v2.test.ts. Use `npx vitest run --exclude 'tests/verification/**' --exclude tests/scenarios.test.ts --exclude tests/pipeline.test.ts --exclude tests/acceptance-v2.test.ts` and run those excluded files yourself outside the sandbox before release.

В тестах `apps/scenario-runner/src/__tests__/executors/cli-agent/` назначай каждому harness отдельный sandbox root вместо общей директории `task-3` и перед ответом дважды запускай затронутые Vitest-тесты.

In SelfyStudio writer contracts, name the release-gate architecture tests that match the task's scope (cwd tests/architecture): api-route-size-budget + large-file-size-budget for apps/api, admin-vue-page-size + nuxt-dead-components for Vue, marketing-i18n-completeness for marketing, migration-safety for migrations. Contract lint refuses a bare `npx vitest run` because it is the whole suite. Evidence: three gate breaks on 2026-10-12 (ArticleBody baseline, seo-clusters size, localization/service.ts 420 LOC).
Before answering a cakekeeper task, compare its changed paths with the task’s owns_paths and restore any generated screenshots or project documentation outside those paths.

Deploy SelfyStudio only from a worktree of current origin/main HEAD; before deploying, check that the active release receipt commit is an ancestor of HEAD (git merge-base --is-ancestor). If it is not, plan with --base set to their merge-base so every rolled-back service is redeployed. Never deploy a task commit that is not on main.

In cakekeeper web code, never call secure-context-only browser APIs directly (crypto.randomUUID, navigator.clipboard, crypto.subtle): the owner's stack runs over plain http on 10.8.0.2, where they are undefined; use the apps/web/src/lib helpers (randomId, copyText) with fallbacks.
The owner does not take part in editorial decisions of Content Factory: design and run scenarios so the AI chief editor decides; never route an editor question to the owner or wait on him for it.

Before reporting a new SelfyStudio paid flow as working, run one real end-to-end order on production through the worker and the bot (a no-payment operator path if needed) and take full-page screenshots of every new page at 375 and 1280 yourself (playwright with executablePath /usr/bin/google-chrome); unit tests, curl 200s and a failed browser_qa are not proof.

Write SelfyStudio migration release evidence (receipt + raw evidence) to /etc/selfystudio/receipts/, never inside the repo or a deploy worktree: deploy.sh's verification chowns root files in the checkout back to ubuntu, and the receipt then fails 'migration receipt parent directory is not protected'.

In cakekeeper, a screens check run in the main checkout (post-merge check) rewrites PNGs in site/cakekeeper/docs/screens and blocks the next merge; when Lane Pilot reports uncommitted docs/screens/*.png in main and no chat edited them, restore them with git checkout -- <files>.
Before dispatch, check every file named in owns_paths/expected_outputs exists (ls) unless the task creates it; use real names such as ui/settings-panel.tsx.

Before putting a tests/architecture gate test into a writer task's verification, run it on current main; if it already fails for files outside the task's owns_paths, leave it out of that task (the integration gate still runs it) and dispatch a separate fix, because the writer cannot make it green and the task blocks with needs_human.

Every lane_pilot_dispatch_writer task must carry display_title (Russian, ≤60 chars, what changes for a person) and kind (feature|fix|check|docs|refactor|research|chore); contract lint rejects tasks without them even though the bridge schema does not list these fields.
Do not design automatic refunds into new SelfyStudio paid products unless the owner asks; failed generations are retried until the order is complete and only an operator refunds.

A SelfyStudio landing page gets at most 10 unique newly generated frames, reused across its blocks; «before»/reference images are real internet frames (Pinterest) re-hosted on our CDN. Never plan one generation per image slot.

Never hand the owner shell commands to paste; when the guard blocks a repo housekeeping step the owner asked for (.gitignore, git rm --cached, commit, push), run it via lane_pilot_errand with authorized: true.

In cakekeeper contracts: a task that adds files under packages/ui-web/src/registry/entries/ must also own packages/ui-web/src/registry/index.ts. A task whose check runs `screens --grep @<group>` must own all of docs/screens/<group>/, or must set CK_SCREENS_OUT to a temp dir and not commit screens.

When a task adds a new compose service to SelfyStudio, the same task must add it to release-services classification, a functional_ready probe and smoke URL in scripts/deploy.sh, and classify every new root file; before the first release create the container once (docker compose build <svc> && up -d --no-deps --no-build <svc>) because deploy.sh refuses services without a running container and only bootstraps agent-egress/scenario-runner.
When an owns_paths check flags a path outside the current task’s owns_paths, do not delete or rewrite that path; keep changes within your listed paths and report the check result.

In apps/marketing locale JSON escape vue-i18n special characters in plain text: write `{'@'}` for @ and `{'|'}` for | (a raw @ breaks message compile and the page returns 500; a raw | is read as a plural separator and cuts the text). Use | only for real plural forms.

Never read `$?` after a pipe (`cmd | tail` always exits 0): redirect output to a file and check the real exit code, use pipefail or run the command bare; test grep gates with `rg -q`, not through head.

In Content Factory do not require a package.json version bump in task contracts; if a task must bump the version, also put tests/publish-panel.test.ts in owns_paths because that test pins the version string.

When verifying a feature that reacts to a thread being idle (e.g. cache keepalive), do not leave a lane_pilot_relay reminder in that same thread due before the check window ends: reminders are BB queued messages with a future sendAt and count as queued work, which can suppress the behaviour under test. Use a reminder due well after the window or check from another thread.

Before redispatching a task in an in_place project, check `git status` of the checkout: if an earlier attempt left its edits uncommitted, verify them yourself and land them (or have them reverted) first, because the new attempt counts pre-existing dirt as not produced and fails with missing expected_outputs.
Before running build or screen verification for a cakekeeper UI task, merge the current cakekeeper main branch so the task worktree includes the shared screen-runner fixes.

After deploying a change to the SelfyStudio photoshoot nav/landings list (seo-landings-nav), bump Redis `admin:read:seo-landings-nav:version` (INCR); the sort=popular list is cached 24 h and keeps serving pre-deploy rows.
In cakekeeper, do not add GitHub Actions or any hosted CI: the owner works alone and only wants local gates (pnpm check:changed / check:all); a workflow just mails him failed runs.

For marketing page work from a prototype, compose pages from the existing native marketing components and write the block-to-component map before dispatching; never port prototype markup into new custom-CSS blocks. In task contracts, list in expected_outputs only files the fix must touch.

On SelfyStudio marketing landings show the works themselves: no model-name chips, prompt captions, «Полный запрос» disclosures or meta lines on example images; before/after pairs must show an obvious change (keep the face, change outfit, scene and light), never a background-only swap.

When a task's acceptance receipt reads merge_conflict, check its state with lane_pilot_reassign_task or the receipt the same turn: if it is validation_failed it is not retried, so redispatch it as <id>.2 with a plan to `git cherry-pick -n <accepted commit>` onto main and resolve the conflict; never trust the «still at work» list for it.

SelfyStudio has a free trial: every new account gets 3 free photoshoot generations (ONBOARDING_BONUS_TOKENS = 3, one per device); the AI chat/editor opens only after the first paid pack. On AI landing pages show «После регистрации — 3 фото со своим лицом бесплатно в фотосессиях» with a second CTA to registration → photoshoots, answer the «без оплаты?» FAQ with it, and never promise free chat/editor generations.
For fixture-note tasks, write and reread the requested `notes/fixture-note-*.md` file to verify its heading and sentence before answering.

In cakekeeper, Lane Pilot checks run with a random sandbox HOME, so every Playwright command must use PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 with an idempotent `playwright install chromium` before `playwright test` (in the npm script or the check); never rely on the host ~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright.

On apps/site every ported prototype block must keep its normal layout with apps/site/public/_site/js/blocks.js blocked (CSS-first; JS adds only motion/interaction). Accept a block task only with a Playwright check that compares section heights with and without blocks.js at 1440 and 375.

In cakekeeper task checks, do not chain `pnpm install` and `playwright install` into the e2e command; use `pnpm check:e2e` (its script installs the browser idempotently) as a separate verification step, so a check run stays minutes, not ~50.

SelfyStudio login providers by visitor IP: CIS (RU, BY, KZ, UZ, KG, TJ, AM, AZ, MD, TM) → Telegram, VK ID, Yandex ID, email; outside the CIS → Telegram, Google, Yandex ID, email (Google replaces only VK; Yandex stays everywhere). Google never for RU. Never pick the set by browser language.

In every SelfyStudio writer task that adds or edits apps/marketing (or cabinet/admin) Vue or TS files, add a lint step scoped to the touched folders (e.g. `npx eslint-compat app/pages/webapp/` with cwd apps/marketing): the deploy gate runs `turbo run lint typecheck` and one ESLint error blocks the release.

If `git push` to GitHub fails with 'Authentication failed', push with the stored gh login: `env -u GH_TOKEN git -c credential.helper= -c 'credential.helper=!gh auth git-credential' push origin main`; the GH_TOKEN env var (and the Env Catalog GH_TOKEN) can be stale and overrides it.

Take product facts (limits, prices, flags, consent predicates) from code, DB and live files, not model priors or task premises; grep every surface (bot, API, cabinet), cite file:line, and let pre-code recon overrule a stale contract claim.

In muse, cargo is not on the sandbox PATH: write every Rust verification command as `PATH=/home/ubuntu/.cargo/bin:$PATH cargo ...` (cwd rust-sync). Evidence: task qtickets-rebind, 2026-10-09, 'cargo: command not found'.

Run task-v2 verification commands from the repo root as `npm -w @selfystudio/<app> exec -- vitest run <filter>` (Lane Pilot ignores the cwd field), and include `npm run test:architecture` for any change to shared marketing components or CSS; the deploy gate runs it.

To push cakekeeper.ru to GitHub, run `env -u GH_TOKEN -u GITHUB_TOKEN git -c credential.helper= -c credential.helper=osxkeychain push origin main`; the GH_TOKEN in the environment and Env Catalog returns 401, the macOS keychain credential works. Do not ask the owner for a token.

Every task that edits .ts or .vue runs the typecheck of its workspace (even test-only or CSS-only edits), and when it adds lines to a file listed in tests/architecture/baselines it also runs `npm run test:architecture` and prefers a compact fix or a sibling module.

After the first failed UI or device fix, stop reasoning from source: reproduce with Playwright device emulation at 375/768/1280 and click through; verify BFF and admin mutations with a real POST or PUT-then-GET on the running container, not mocks or static screenshots.

In Content Factory db/store.ts only append new entries at the end of MIGRATIONS; never insert, reorder or edit an existing migration. The hub records migrations by index and refuses to reload the plugin otherwise.
Verification commands run from the workspace root regardless of the cwd field; for a subpackage write `cd <pkg> && npm ...` in the command itself.

In bb-plugin-lane-pilot, exclude the whole 'tests/verification/**' folder (not only sandbox*.test.ts), plus tests/guard*.test.ts and tests/native-session-hooks.test.ts, from full-suite verification commands unless the task changes that folder: git-sync and sandbox tests fail inside Lane Pilot's Seatbelt check.

Before bumping a git-installed BB plugin's version, check its install range with `bb plugin list` (e.g. office-viewer is `^0.8.1`): a 0.x caret range does not accept the next minor (0.9.0), and reinstalling with a new range deletes the plugin's settings, so stay inside the range (0.8.10).

In SelfyStudio contracts never use `npx vitest related <file> --run` with cwd apps/api or apps/worker; name the direct test file instead (e.g. apps/api src/lib/__tests__/onboarding-presets.test.ts, apps/worker src/__tests__/prepare-provider-params.test.ts). `related` on a shared lib pulls the whole package (344 files) and fails in the sandbox on unrelated warnings. Also list every existing test of the touched module (grep __tests__ for its exports) in owns_paths.

During cakekeeper testing, ignore 152-FZ data-location constraints and Yandex Cloud: host everything (web, api, worker, Postgres, MinIO) in self-hosted Docker; do not raise 152-FZ or Russian hosting until the owner says the production move has started.
After the owner hands work to another thread, send that thread nothing beyond the single handoff message: no status notes, no follow-ups; close own sessions, watchers and worktrees and stop.
List in expected_outputs only files the change must touch; put files that may or may not change in owns_paths, otherwise writers add filler edits just to pass the check.

In apps/marketing (nuxt-i18n with experimental.preload) a t() key used only in a client-only branch (shown after hydration, polling or a click) may be missing in the browser; verify such UI in a production build (`npm run build` + `.output/server/index.mjs` + a playwright check for no raw keys), not only with vitest mounts that load full messages.
Sandbox drill: keep sandbox notes under notes/ only, never in the repo root

To ship a BB plugin from plugins/bb-plugin-*, after git push run `bash /Users/vechkasov/Documents/BB-сервис/infrastructure/plugin-deploy/bb-plugin-push <plugin-id>` and confirm `bb plugin list` shows the new version; `bb plugin reload` alone does not update the hub, which keeps its own copy of the folder.

In the Pokecut theme never override the desktop sidebar panel's top (BB places it below the macOS chrome row); stretch it with bottom: 0; height: auto. Desktop sidebar markup has data-side on the outer group div, so target [data-side="left"] > [data-sidebar="panel"], not [data-sidebar="panel"][data-side="left"] (phone-only).

Verify with commands scoped to the workspace and proven green on clean main first: never `npm run test -- <file>` in apps/api (the arg goes to node --test); confirm at least one test ran, since --passWithNoTests and a wrong filter or cwd pass on zero tests.

In cakekeeper, give each task only the checks of the packages it touches (pnpm check:changed or per-package --filter); add e2e or screenshot runs only when the task changes that user flow, and run the full gate (pnpm check:all) once per batch before pushing.

Build and deploy only from a clean committed tree or a clean main snapshot, rebuild just the affected service (--no-deps), never while generations are in flight, and write backup plus rollback SQL before changing live money data (token_packages, system_settings).
When the owner points to an existing reference (e.g. studio.vechkasov.pro), copy its approach; do not add extra engines, models or settings screens it does not have without asking first.

Before making a failing test pass by reverting code, check git log for a deliberate recent commit that changed that code (owner decision, perf); if one exists, update the stale test instead of reverting. Evidence: fix-marketing-contract-tests (694f666114, 2026-10-09) reverted owner-approved homepage NuxtImg resizing (32365db508) to satisfy stale photo-surface-cdn.spec.ts.

On SelfyStudio AI generator landings (/ii-redaktor-foto, /neiroseti*), sell what a person can make with the image generators (use cases with real outputs and prompts); do not cross-sell site tools (Pixar, docs photo, greeting cards) there. Photoshoots-by-example may stay as one promo.

The owner opens cakekeeper test stacks from another device over WireGuard, not on the Mac mini: build and run them with WEB_ORIGIN/NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL/API_BASE_URL on http://10.8.0.2:<port> (Mac mini WG address) and give him 10.8.0.2 links, never localhost.

In Vue scoped styles, never write `:deep(.root-class …)` or `[data-v] .root-class` for the component's own root element: the scope attribute sits on the root itself, so the rule needs an ancestor that does not exist and matches nothing. Anchor on the root outside :deep (`.root-class :deep(.child)`), and test the compiled CSS or computed styles, not just the template.

Layout work on marketing pages is not done until it has been checked in a production build (nuxt build plus the built server) with screenshots. Dev-server or unit-test evidence is not enough: CSS linked by URL or imported only in dev can vanish in production. The PM screenshots production right after each deploy and rolls back at once if the layout broke.

After merging a task that adds a dependency to package.json, run `npm install` in the base checkout before the next task starts: writer worktrees mirror the base node_modules, so a missing package breaks typecheck for every following task.
Before a production deploy, confirm the commit is on main and check the site healthcheck returns 200 after it.
Before answering, run `npm test` in the project root and do not finish while it fails; quote the passing line in your answer.
